verdict.summary: Custom distribution (one store or one Plus organization) needs no review and takes minutes. Reaching unrelated merchants requires Public distribution, App Store registration and app review. Reviews are reported to take 1-2 weeks per cycle.
verdict.hands_on_effort: 30-60 min for your own store; 1-3 days of prep for public review
verdict.approval_wait: None for Custom distribution; roughly 1-4 weeks (reported, no official SLA) for Public

gates.name: Dev Dashboard app, Custom distribution or dev store
gates.unlocks: Connect your own store, stores in one Plus organization, or development stores. No approval.
limits: Distribution choice cannot be changed after you select it
Custom apps cannot charge merchants through Shopify billing
Scopes marked 'Shopify approval required' still need Shopify approval
Personal customer fields on non-development stores need protected customer data approval

gates.name: Invited stores (dev stores / Custom installs)
gates.unlocks: Installs on development stores, one store, or one Plus organization's stores.
limits: Custom distribution is capped to a single store or one Plus organization
You cannot work around the cap by making one Custom app per merchant
Unlisted public apps still need review before installing on production stores (staff forum reply)
No official install cap for unreviewed public apps was found
Reports say any partner dev store with the Client ID can install an unreviewed public app

gates.name: Public distribution with App Store review
limits: Must use Billing API or Managed Pricing for charges
Review time is not officially published; community reports range from about 5 days to nearly a month
Protected customer data review is separate
Expiring offline tokens required for public apps (new apps since 1 April 2026; all by 1 January 2027)

steps.title: Decide distribution model
steps.detail: Choose Custom if only one store or one Plus organization will connect. Choose Public if unrelated merchants will install. The choice cannot be changed later.
gotchas: Public requires App Store registration with a one-time fee

steps.title: Get a Partner account and open the Dev Dashboard
steps.detail: Create a Partner account, then sign in at dev.shopify.com. New custom apps can no longer be created in the Shopify admin, so you build them here.

steps.title: Create the app
steps.detail: Create an app in the Dev Dashboard, not from an app template, for the manual OAuth path. Pick the distribution model. Copy the client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Declare minimal scopes
steps.detail: List scopes in the access_scopes section of the app configuration. Composio's default list is long, so request only what your agent uses. Scopes labeled 'approval required' need Shopify approval first.

steps.title: Add Composio's redirect URI
steps.detail: In the app's allowed redirection URLs, paste the exact callback URL shown in your Composio auth config. Composio sources list two different callback paths, so use the one the auth config shows.

values.label: Redirect URI
values.value: Composio callback URL (see the Composio callout on this page)

steps.title: Create the Composio auth config and connect a store
steps.detail: Choose OAuth2 for the shopify toolkit, enter your client ID and secret and the store subdomain, then authorize on your store. Composio has no managed Shopify app.

steps.title: Test on a development store or invited store
steps.detail: Install on a dev store or your Custom-distribution store and run a test call. Note that online tokens last at most 24 hours.
gotchas: Personal customer fields won't return on non-development stores until protected customer data is approved

steps.title: Prepare the public listing
steps.detail: Draft a privacy policy, listing copy, a distinctive app name, 3-6 screenshots at 1600x900, a 1200x1200 icon, reviewer instructions and a screencast. Make sure the app runs OAuth first and does not rely on pop-ups.

steps.title: Implement billing, GDPR webhooks and expiring tokens
steps.detail: Charge through the Billing API or Managed Pricing. Make the GDPR endpoints work. Request expiring offline tokens (expiring=1) and avoid APIs deprecating within 90 days.

steps.title: Request protected customer data and restricted scopes
steps.detail: If you use personal customer data, apply for protected customer data access. Contact Shopify Support for approval-gated scopes outside the normal flow.

steps.title: Submit for review and wait
steps.detail: Register for the App Store, submit, and answer reviewer feedback. Each pause-and-resubmit loop adds a cycle.

requirements.detail: Needed for the manual OAuth path, along with an app not generated from a template.
Verify the nonce, the HMAC against the client secret, and that the shop is a valid myshopify.com hostname.
Required in the App Store listing.
Public apps, including unlisted ones, cannot use their own payment system.
Reported to be needed before approval, per a third-party guide.
Required for public apps; custom apps are unaffected.

scopes.effect: Needed for orders older than 60 days. Declare it with read_orders or write_orders; it has its own approval requirements.
Labeled 'Shopify approval required'. Approval must come before you can declare them.
Personal fields need a separate protected customer data review, not just a scope declaration.
Declared in app configuration. No special approval is mentioned in the findings.

blockers.symptom: Cannot create a custom app in the Shopify admin
blockers.cause: The admin path closed on 1 January 2026.
blockers.fix: Create the app in the Dev Dashboard and install it on your store.

blockers.symptom: 'Shopify needs to review the app before it can be installed' on an unlisted install
blockers.cause: Public apps, including unlisted ones, need review before production installs.
blockers.fix: Use Custom distribution for one store or one Plus organization, or submit for review.

blockers.symptom: Customer personal fields return empty or null
blockers.cause: Protected customer data is not approved.
blockers.fix: Apply for protected customer data access, or use a development store for testing.

blockers.symptom: Authentication errors from non-expiring tokens on a public app
blockers.cause: Public apps must use expiring offline tokens by 1 January 2027.
blockers.fix: Pass expiring=1 at token exchange and handle refresh.

composio.note: Composio has no managed OAuth app for Shopify, so you must register your own from the start. Authorization and token URLs are per-shop (https://{subdomain}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/...). Default scopes are long (36 listed in the toolkit, only the first 8 shown here), so trim them. Confirm which Composio callback URL applies: the toolkit record and the probe gave different paths.

open_questions: No documented install cap for unreviewed public apps was found.
Review turnaround has no official SLA; the 5-business-day figure is unverified.
The official requirements and review-process pages were not fetchable, so rejection reasons come from community sources.
The official protected customer data page was not fetched; Level 1/2 details are third-party.
Whether a non-review unlisted option exists in the Dev Dashboard is unconfirmed; staff replies say no.
Which Composio redirect URI is correct (/api/v1/auth-apps/add vs /api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback) needs confirming.
Refresh-token lifetime for expiring tokens (about 90 days) is not officially confirmed.
Invalid client_id handling at the authorize endpoint could not be observed.
